messages.author: 7c126bd2af2acc00
messages.subject: interactive annotating
parts: Hi, I was wondering whether there is a way to conditionally annotate some points but hide the annotation until you click on a point. The annotation will be in a separate column. (My specific question is that I want to annotate around 100 points out of ~2000 in a scatter plot. I don't want to let all annotation show up because it will take up the whole plotting area) Thanks for any reply.

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: interactive annotating
parts:
There was a special SVG package that could output plots with annotation when you hovered over them. It required that the plots be loaded by a web browser though. Can't remember where I saw it though. 

Some stuff about similar things here:
https://groups.google.com/forum/?fromgroups#!topic/ggplot2/AnZNHmKoqn4
and here:
http://stackoverflow.com/questions/8972642/how-do-you-relate-ggplot2-grobs-back-to-the-data

HTH.
